title: Logistics IT Integration and Support (LIIS) Capability Modernization, Deployment, and Support (CMDS) Multiple Award Contract (MAC)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVAIR.NAVAIR HQS.FLEET READINESS CENTER
detail_text: This Notification is to provide an update to the anticipated award date for Solicitation N68520-24-R-0020. The Government has received requests for updates from Offerors regarding the status of the evaluation and anticipated award date. The Government currently anticipates an award date by end of May 2026. Please continue to monitor SAM.gov for additional updates.
